title: hayai node
description: Each metric that hayaid exports (docs/hayaid.md, Metrics).

panels.title: Block height
panels.description: zcash_chain_verified_block_height: the committed tip.

panels.title: Header height
panels.description: hayai_sync_header_height: the best header chain (full mode).

panels.title: Height on disk
panels.description: state_finalized_block_height: the newest block whose coins are in the coins store on disk. hayai_base_height: the base in memory.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: zcash_net_peers: peers after the handshake. hayai_peers: each connection of the relay. hayai_sync_peers: peers of the block download.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: hayai_build_info: version, chain, mode, crypto backend and coins backend of the node.

panels.title: Heights
panels.description: Committed tip (zcash_chain_verified_block_height, state_memory_best_committed_block_height), header chain, base in memory, height on disk.

targets.legendFormat: tip of the state in memory

panels.title: Blocks for each second
panels.description: rate of zcash_chain_verified_block_total over 1 minute, and the blocks that the download stored (sync_downloaded_block_count).

panels.title: Blocks not committed
panels.description: For each minute: rejected blocks, blocks that a reorg disconnected, blocks without the hashBlockCommitments check.

panels.title: Block download
panels.description: hayai_sync_requests_in_flight: requests without an answer. sync_downloads_in_flight: requests plus downloaded blocks that wait for the validator. hayai_sync_bodies_withheld: 1 while a header chain is out of the fork choice.

panels.title: Held bytes
panels.description: hayai_sync_held_bytes: bytes of the downloaded blocks that wait for the validator.

panels.title: P2P bytes
panels.description: rate of zcash_net_in_bytes_total and zcash_net_out_bytes_total over 1 minute.

panels.title: Last block (one value for each block; docs/hayaid.md, Block clock)
Received to validated and to committed against block height
panels.description: hayai_last_block_received_to_validated_seconds and hayai_last_block_received_to_committed_seconds against hayai_last_block_height. One point for each block that a scrape read.

panels.title: Received to template ready against block height
panels.description: hayai_last_template_received_to_ready_seconds against hayai_last_template_tip_height, for the full template. At the tip the template can be ready before the block is validated (speculative tip). The panel 'Template of the last block' has both templates against time.

panels.title: Contextual commit and commit against block height
panels.description: hayai_last_block_contextual_commit_seconds (stages context, trees, history and the push of the layer) and hayai_last_block_commit_seconds (valid verdict to commit_finish).

panels.title: Size against block height
panels.description: hayai_last_block_size_bytes against hayai_last_block_height.

panels.title: Durations of the last block
panels.description: received to validated, start to validated (validation), validated to committed (commit), received to committed, contextual commit.

panels.title: Template of the last block
panels.description: hayai_last_template_received_to_ready_seconds: reception of the tip block to the first empty and the first full template on it.

panels.title: Validation stages of the last block
panels.description: hayai_last_block_validate_stage_seconds, without the stage total. prepare_unknown: transactions that the prepared store did not have. scripts, shielded: signatures and proofs. lookup, context, trees, history: checks against the state.

panels.title: Size of the last block
panels.description: hayai_last_block_size_bytes.

panels.title: Transactions of the last block
panels.description: hayai_last_block_transactions (with the coinbase), and hayai_last_block_prepared_transactions: found in the prepared store (known) or prepared at block time (unknown).

panels.title: Source of the last block
panels.description: hayai_last_block_source: 1 for the source of the last block. download, compact, legacy, local (a block of this node), stored, upstream_rpc.

panels.title: Last block
panels.description: hayai_last_block_height and hayai_last_block_hash_suffix (the last 12 hexadecimal digits of the hash, as an integer).

panels.title: Last blocks
panels.description: One row for each scrape, newest first: the gauges of the last block. The same block has several rows.

panels.title: Received to committed
panels.description: hayai_block_receive_to_commit_seconds: mean and quantiles. Reception of a block to the moment at which it is the tip.

panels.title: Received to validated
panels.description: hayai_block_received_to_validated_seconds: mean and quantiles. Reception of a block to its valid verdict.

panels.title: Contextual commit
panels.description: hayai_contextual_commit_duration_seconds: mean and quantiles. Stages context, trees, history and the push of the layer.

panels.title: commit_start to commit_finish
panels.description: hayai_commit_duration_seconds: mean and quantiles. hayai_commit_duration_seconds.

panels.title: Body prebuild
panels.description: hayai_prebuild_duration_seconds: mean and quantiles. One prebuild of a body: the template of the node or a candidate of a peer.

panels.title: Block verify time by result
panels.description: sync_block_verify_duration_seconds: reception of a block to its commit (success) or to its rejection (failure). Mean.

panels.title: Validation stages
panels.description: hayai_validate_stage_duration_seconds: mean of each stage.

panels.title: Template after a tip change
panels.description: hayai_template_latency_seconds: tip change to the published template. hayai_block_received_to_template_seconds: reception of the block to the first template on it. Means.

panels.title: Mempool size
panels.description: zcash_mempool_size_transactions: transactions in the prepared store.

panels.title: Mempool bytes
panels.description: zcash_mempool_size_bytes: wire bytes of the prepared store.

panels.title: Mempool rejections
panels.description: hayai_mempool_rejected_total for each minute, by reason.

panels.title: Prepared store use
panels.description: Block transactions from the prepared store (hits) and prepared at block time (misses), for each minute.

panels.title: Template updates
panels.description: hayai_template_updates_total for each minute: full and changed templates.

panels.title: Prebuilt commits
panels.description: hayai_prebuilt_commits_total for each minute, by origin of the body.

panels.title: Compact relay
panels.description: Counters of Relay::metrics() for each minute.

panels.title: Candidate blocks
panels.description: Candidate blocks sent, resolved from a stored candidate, and fetched in full, for each minute.

panels.title: Trace rows dropped
panels.description: hayai_trace_dropped_rows_total by table. A value above 0 means that the trace tables have gaps.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: rpc_requests_total for each second, by method and status.

panels.title: Mean service time
panels.description: rpc_request_duration_seconds: mean by method.

panels.title: Errors and active requests
panels.description: rpc_errors_total for each minute by method and code, and rpc_active_requests.

panels.title: Upstream verdicts
panels.description: hayai_shadow_agreements_total and hayai_shadow_disagreements_total. No data in full mode.

panels.title: Trust limits
panels.description: Coins, nullifiers, anchors and header bits that shadow mode took from upstream.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: rate of process_cpu_seconds_total over 1 minute: CPU cores in use.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes.

panels.title: Coins cache
panels.description: hayai_coins_cache_entries and hayai_coins_store_coins (memory backend).

panels.title: Coins cache memory
panels.description: hayai_coins_cache_bytes.

panels.title: Sidecar of the machine (race_* metrics of the node-exporter of the variable)
Container CPU
panels.description: rate of race_node_cpu_seconds_total over 1 minute: CPU cores of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice). Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: race_node_memory_bytes (memory.current) and race_node_memory_peak_bytes (memory.peak) of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice), with the page cache. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Container disk I/O
panels.description: rate of race_node_io_read_bytes_total and race_node_io_write_bytes_total over 1 minute: io.stat of the cgroup v2 of the node container (slice race-<node>.slice). Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Data directory
panels.description: race_node_data_bytes: disk blocks of the data directory of the node (du), each 60 s. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Template served after a block
panels.description: race_last_block_template_served_seconds: first getblocktemplate answer of the RPC caller on the last block minus the commit time of the block on this machine. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Template transactions after a block
panels.description: race_last_block_template_transactions: transactions of the first answer without longpollid at or after the first answer on the last block. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: getblocktemplate time on the client side
panels.description: race_rpc_getblocktemplate_seconds: mean time of a call without longpollid on the client side (rate of _sum / rate of _count over 5 minutes). The node metric rpc_request_duration_seconds has the wait of each long poll. Source: the sidecar of the machine (scripts/race_sidecar.py), through node-exporter.

panels.title: Machine (the node-exporter of the variable; the machine runs one node)
Machine CPU
panels.description: Share of the CPU time of the machine that is not idle. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Machine memory in use
panels.description: MemTotal minus MemAvailable. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Disk in use
panels.description: Used bytes of the file systems ext4, xfs and btrfs, one time for each device. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Bytes read and written for each second, whole disks only. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.

panels.title: Machine network
panels.description: Bytes received and sent for each second, without the loopback and the Docker interfaces. Source: node-exporter of the machine. The machine runs one node.
